training_data.name: ReasonMed
training_data.quote: ReasonMed is the largest open-source medical reasoning dataset to date, containing 370 K high-quality question–answer examples with multi-step chain-of-thought (CoT) rationales and concise summaries. We distilled these from 1.75 M initial reasoning paths generated by three competitive large-language models.

description.text: This EpistemeAI/Reasoning-Medical0.1-27B is designed for advanced medical reasoning in professional medicine, medical genetics, college biology/medicine, and clinical knowledge. The model was fine-tuned on a large-scale dataset of 100000 records, specifically curated by blending various public medical reasoning datasets, incorporating Chain-of-Thought reasoning to improve step-by-step medical related questions. Training was performed using the GRPO trainer with the Unsloth optimization method for efficient fine-tuning.

serving.text_only_input_quote: Type: Causal Language Model with Vision Encoder. The card also shows an Image Input example and a Video Input example.
serving.notes: The card's thinking-mode recommendation is temperature 1.0, top_p 0.95, top_k 20, repetition_penalty 1.0, which differs from generation_config.json temperature 0.6. The text example uses max_tokens 81920, temperature 1.0, top_p 0.95, top_k 20. Native context is 262,144 tokens; the card says YaRN can extend it to 1,010,000. Safetensors total is 27,781,427,952 parameters. The repository has full weight shards and no adapter_config.json. The chat template has no fixed medical system prompt. The dataset example system line is "You are a medical reasoning assistant. Solve the task carefully using medically accurate reasoning. For exam-style questions, end with the final answer clearly." The mix dataset is gated (auto) and has two parquet shards. The line "Training Stage: Pre-training & Post-training" sits in the architecture block copied with the base model and is not a separate training objective for this checkpoint. The Unsloth sentence "trained 2x faster" is library boilerplate. GitHub search found no training repository for this checkpoint. Papers listed are bibliography entries on the mix and constituent dataset cards; the model-name search found no paper that names this repository. Those papers were not read in full.

evaluation_reported.text: MMLU-Pro Biology exact_match 0.93 (2-shot); MMLU-ProX Biology exact_match 0.968 (2-shot); MedQA acc 0.969 (2-shot); HealthBench Pro acc 0.54. Comparators in the tables include Reasoning Medical 27B, MedGemma 1 27B, Opus 4.8, GPT 5.5, and Kimi-K2.6.
